title: Baladi Zucchini Stuffed with Brown Rice
subtitle: in a tamarind and pomegranate sauce
description: Small zucchini stuffed with brown rice, herbs, dried mint and raisins, then slow-cooked in a sweet and sour tamarind broth until it reduces to a syrup.

steps.text: Hollow out the zucchini with a melon baller or teaspoon, leaving almost only the skin.
Optional: line a wide, shallow pot with a single layer of sliced tomatoes (or onions), season with salt and pepper and drizzle with a little olive oil.

Mix all the filling ingredients (rice, raisins, dried mint, lemon zest, chopped parsley, grated tomato, salt and pepper) in a bowl and leave for about 10 minutes. Fill each zucchini about three quarters full, pressing the filling down lightly with your fingers.
Arrange the stuffed zucchini snugly in the pot, scattering any leftover filling between them.

Mix the boiling water with the tamarind paste and the crushed dried lime until the tamarind dissolves into an amber broth. Season with salt and pepper and adjust the seasoning. Pour gently over the zucchini just to cover, adding more boiling water if needed. Drizzle with pomegranate molasses and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat, lay parsley stalks on top if using, cover and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the lid, taste the cooking liquid and adjust with salt and pomegranate molasses. Cook for about 15 minutes over medium heat until the liquid reduces to a syrupy consistency and serve hot.
